title: One API for 20 messaging systems
text: Pure PHP publish, receive and ack across 20 systems, 13 protocol stacks and 6 frameworks. A unified messaging client in pure PHP A pure-PHP messaging and event streaming client with one publish, receive and ack API for 20 systems, 20 drivers and six framework adapters.

title: One API for every message system
text: messaging-php implements publishing and consumption in pure PHP: TCP uses stream_socket_client, cloud APIs use Guzzle, and no broker SDK or extension is required. Twenty product names collapse into 13 protocol stacks. Switching brokers usually means changing the driver and connection config while business code stays the same. One Manager facade 20 drivers implemented Six optional adapters

title: Capabilities from publish to ack
text: One contract, explicit capabilities and pure-PHP transports across brokers.

title: Unified API
text: publish, receive, consume, ack and reject share one calling convention.

title: Pure-PHP transports
text: TCP runs on stream_socket_client, with protocol codecs written in PHP.

title: Capability model
text: capabilities() answers at runtime; unsupported features throw instead of degrading silently.

title: Framework adapters
text: Laravel, ThinkPHP, webman, Hyperf, Yii2 and Yii3; Composer registers each framework through its native mechanism on install.

title: Connection manager
text: default plus connections config, cached by name, with disconnect() for reconnects.

title: Four test layers
text: 739 unit/protocol tests plus fake-broker, contract and heavy Docker integration matrices.
